description: Renames a brand or changes its timezone. The name is for display; matching uses the self entity's aliases (shruwd_set_entity). The timezone moves the day boundary for cycles and rollups from the next cycle on. The domain cannot change: it defines the self entity, so a new domain is a new brand.

brandId.description: Brand id or slug, from shruwd_get_workspace, shruwd_list_brands or shruwd_create_brand. The slug is the segment in the dashboard URL (/brands/{slug}).

name: shruwd_update_brand
title: Update brand
